topic: Football YouTubers recreate impossible World Cup goals in BC Place (Vancouver) with a score meter, challenge video
hero: Group of YouTubers (Boume, DJ Diveny, Tom Harris and others)
hook: Score meter (Messi 4, Ronaldo 2, Quagliarella 5, Zidane 1) over replay clips of famous goals being recreated
subtitle_style: Small white labels with names (BOUME, TOM, DORIAN) with country flag lower-left; scoreboard bar at left; yellow COMING UP tag lower-left
reaction_overlays: Vertical 1-6 meter graphic, cartoon animations, fire/explosion VFX on celebration, face-cam inset corner, flag cutouts, comedic zoom reactions
transition_summary: Hard cuts, mix of locked wide shots and close reactions; moderate pace ~4-6 cuts per 10 s in first minute (cuts every 1-2 s early)
audio_note: Voice-over host speech (transcript: today we are recreating impossible World Cup goals), likely music bed

reuse_segments.what: Preview of recreated goals with colour meter
Challenge segments in stadium with players
reuse_segments.how_to_reuse: own filmed content, no rights issue if owned
